incident.error: GET /profile/{user_id} crashes when email is missing.
incident.failed_test: test_profile_requires_email fails because the endpoint raises instead of returning HTTP 422.
incident.git_diff: HEAD~1..HEAD changes the missing-email guard to an unguarded email.lower() call.

root_cause.cause: The optional email parameter is dereferenced with .lower() before checking whether it is None.
evidence: email is declared optional in the endpoint signature.
The failing test requests the endpoint without email.
The traceback reports NoneType has no attribute lower.

patch.explanation: Reject the missing optional email with the API's expected 422 response before normalizing it.

    assert response.json() == {"detail": "email is required"}
tests.expected_result: A request without email returns HTTP 422 and does not raise AttributeError.
